_methodology: Run measure.sh 5x, take max(wall_s) and max(rss_kb) per scenario.
_note: loadfile_200k rss_kb raised 30492->38464 by PR #756 (Phase 2). The scenario's --output-path is a /tmp dir that PathValidator rejects, so every run exits on the error path. Phase 2 moved the column-profile load (an ~8MB one-time allocation) ahead of output-path validation, so the failing path now pays it. Success-path RSS is unchanged (verified ~60MB new vs ~60MB main); the gate measures the error path only.
